summary: Annovis Bio filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 20, 2026, to correct a typographical error in the audit-fee disclosure of its proxy statement for the annual meeting held June 17, 2026. Corrected figures from Ernst & Young LLP: 2025 audit fees $415,000 and audit-related $100,000 (total $515,000); 2024 audit fees $375,000 and audit-related $107,045 (total $482,045); no tax or other fees. No transaction, ownership change, or structural event is disclosed. No deal terms apply; nothing for risk-arb.
